name: Kendall K2 simplified timekeeper
summary: Kendall's K2, a simplified version of the H4 and K1 marine timekeepers, issued by the Board of Longitude to Phipps's 1773 Arctic voyage.
description: Kendall’s K2, commissioned as a simplified H4/K1-type marine timekeeper.
tier_reason: A particular simplified copy fits fine detail; keep it distinct from H4 and K1 and retain its independent voyage history. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.

impact.note: A simplified copy of a known instrument carried on a few voyages, followed by one further copy.

why: The Board of Longitude sought a simpler and cheaper timekeeper of the H4 type for naval use.

places.note: HMS Racehorse, 1773 Phipps Arctic expedition (waters north of Svalbard)
